verses.text: Ha junel, t'a a las tres yik yemk'ualil, molan ix b'at winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios, yujto icha chi' yorail slesalwi heb' aj Israel ta'.

Ay jun winh, junjun k'u tzul chelchajkan t'a yol sti' jun spuertail yamaq'uil templo chi', haton t'a jun skuch Wach' Yilji, yik sk'an tumin winh t'a heb' sk'och t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi', yujto max yal sb'ey winh yiktax ix alji.
Haxo ix yilan winh sk'och winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan t'a stemplo Dios chi', ayik wan yoch heb' winh ta', ix sk'anan stumin winh t'a heb' winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi' ix och k'elan t'a winh. --Kotanh k'elan t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix och k'elan winh t'a heb' winh. Ha snaan winh to ol ak'jok jab'ok stumin winh yuj heb' winh.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Pedro chi' t'a winh: --Ha in tik, malaj in tumin. Palta ay jun syal wuuj, a yet' jun chi' ol in kolwaj t'ayach. Yuj spoder Jesucristo aj Nazaret k'eanh waan, b'eyanh, xchi winh t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Pedro chi' ix yaman sk'ab' winh t'a swach'. Ix sketzank'e waan winh. Elanhchamel ix och yip yok winh yet' yip sjaj yok winh schab'il.
Ix k'e juknaj winh, ix och ijan winh sb'eyi. Ix och winh t'a yol yamaq'uil templo chi' yet' heb' winh, sk'e chennaj winh ayik sb'eyek' winh. Ix yalanpax wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios.
Haxo heb' anima ayek' ta', ix laj yil heb' sb'eyek' winh, ix yab'an heb' yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a Dios.
Yuj chi' ix te sat sk'ool heb' yuj tas ix aj sb'o winh, yujto yojtak heb' to junjun k'u k'ojanem winh sk'an tumin t'a sti' spuertail yamaq'uil templo chi', haton t'a jun skuch Wach' Yilji.

Ha winh ix b'oxi yok chi', junnhej tzek' winh yet' winhaj Pedro yet' winhaj Juan chi'. Haxo heb' anima smasanil, ix te sat sk'ool heb'. Yuj chi' ix smolb'an sb'a heb' smasanil t'a stz'ey heb' winh ayik ayek' heb' winh t'a jun stentail stemplo Dios skuchan Yik Salomón.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Pedro chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Ex wetisraelal, ¿tas yuj ste sat he k'ool onh heyilani? ¿Tas yuj tzex och k'elan t'ayonh? Manh he na'a to yuj ko jelanil mato yuj ko wach'il ix b'oxi sb'ey jun winh tik.

Ha ko Diosal, hanheja' jun Dios b'aj yak'nakem sb'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj paxi te niwan ix aj yelk'och Jesús, haton Yuninal. Palta a ex tik, ix eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yajal. Ha winh yajal skuchan Pilato, snib'ej winh ix yak'el t'a libre. Ha exxo maj yal-laj he k'ool.
Ha Jesús chi', yiknhej Dios yaji, te tojol sb'eyb'al. Palta a exxo tik, maj he cha el-laj t'a libre. Haxo jun winh mak'umcham anima ix he k'anelta sk'exulok.
Icha chi' ix eyutej he milancham jun aj k 'inal. Palta ha Dios ix ak'anxi pitzwok t'a skal heb' chamnak. Ha jun tik skak' wal och ko b'a testigoal yuj.

Ha jun winh tzeyil tik, eyojtak winh, toxonton max yal sb'ey winh. Palta a Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok winh. Yujnhej to skak'och Jesús chi' t'a ko k'ool ix b'oxi sk'ool winh sik'lab'il t'a eyichanh he masanil.
Haxo tiknaik ex wetchonhab', wojtak to ix eyak' miljokcham Jesús chi' yujto manh eyojtakok tas wan he k'ulani. Icha pax chi' heb' yajal, manh yojtakok heb'.
Palta icha chi' ix yutej Dios yak'an elk'och tas alb'ilkan yuj heb' schekab'. Yujto yalnakkan heb' to a Cristo yowalil ol yab' syail.
Yuj chi', naek he b'a. Q'uexek he b'eyb'al, aq'ek och he pensar t'a Dios, yik wach' ol sukchaj sat he mul. Tato icha chi', ay jun pekti' ol yak' Dios Kajal tzalajk'olal t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik.
Ha Dios ol chekanxikot Jesús t'a schaelal, yujto a ak'jinak yopisio yoch Cristoal t'ayex yet' t'ayonh.

Palta a tiknaik, yowalil ol kannhej Jesucristo t'a satcha'anh, masanto ol jawok jun pekti' ayik ol b'o yaj masanil tas yuj Dios. Icha chi' yutejnak yalankanel t'a sti' heb' schekab' t'a peka', haton heb' yiknhej Dios yaji.

Haxo winhaj Moisés alannakkan icha tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham: Ha Dios Kajal ol sik'anelta jun schekab' t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', icha ix yutej in sik'anelta a in tik. Tzeyak' wal och he chikin t'a jantaknhej tas ol yal t'ayex.
Yujto a mach manh ol ak'anoch schikin smaklan yab' tas ol yala', ol satxikanel t'a skal heb' ketchonhab', xchinakkan Moisés chi' t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.
Ha jantaknhej heb' schekab' Dios ek'nak t'a peka', yiktax yek'nak winhaj Samuel, ix laj yalkan yab'ixal jun pekti' wan yek' tik heb'.

Palta a ex tik, yinhtil ex kan heb' winh alannakkanel slolonel Dios chi' ket'ok. Yuj chi', ayik yak'annakpaxkan strato Dios yet' heb' ko mam kicham chi', yak'nakpaxkan t'ayonh yet' heb'. Haton jun strato tik yak'nakkan t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Xchi icha tik: Yuj inhtilal, ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi Dios t'a winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ayik ix yak'anxi pitzwok Yuninal, a t'ayonh ix sb'ab'laj chekejkoti, yik wach' tzonh kolchaji, skaktankan ko chukal junjun onh, xchi winhaj Pedro chi' t'a heb'.
